findings.rule: Threads terminating against a shoulder require an undercut, relief groove, or standard runout.
findings.reasoning: F7 explicitly describes an external M20 thread running up to the shoulder with no undercut/relief groove, leaving no tool clearance and preventing a proper full thread at the shoulder.
findings.correction: Add a thread undercut/relief groove or specify an appropriate thread runout at the shoulder.

findings.rule: Title-block heat-treatment data must agree with the drawing notes.
findings.reasoning: The title block gives heat treatment as '---', but N1 requires case hardening to 55-60 HRC with case depth 0.8-2 mm, creating a conflicting/missing heat-treatment specification.
findings.correction: Enter the required case-hardening specification, or reference N1, in the title-block heat-treatment field.

findings.rule: Functional mating diameters require an explicit tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: The part is a pin sleeve and F2 identifies D4/D12 as the inner bore, but the ⌀20 bore has no explicit tolerance or fit class; only a general tolerance would apply, which may not define the required pin fit.
findings.correction: Specify an appropriate fit/tolerance for the functional bore, or explicitly identify the bore as non-functional/REF if no fit is required.
